posts.title: The Blue Wave, what does it mean?
posts.description: Not a fucking thing. Red and Blue both do not give a fuck about us. They care about money and power. Everyone thinks something magical happened yesterday. It didn't. It is just the same old song and dance, now with a different bandleader. Four years, it happens again... New bandleader, same fucking song... 🤬
